برای استفاده کامل `android-shizuku-cli --help` را در شل اجرا کن. فرقی نمی‌کند اتصال از Shizuku، AXManager یا Sui باشد — سطح دستور یکسان است.

Install any one of Shizuku (RikkaApps), AXManager (Axeron), or Sui (RikkaApps) — all three implement the same protocol and are fully interchangeable. Shizuku and AXManager are regular apps activated via wireless ADB. Sui is for already-rooted devices: it installs as a Magisk/KernelSU module, needs no app, and stays active across reboots. On KernelSU or APatch, Sui also requires a Zygisk implementation (Zygisk Next / ReZygisk / NeoZygisk) — without it Sui will not load. Install one, then return here.

Open the manager app and start the service via wireless ADB (no PC) or root. After it shows running, return here.\n\nUsing AXManager? Also enable Settings → "AX-Permission Intercept" inside AXManager — only that switch makes AXManager push its Shizuku-compatible binder to Minis.
